HexKagune 6.0.7 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Changed in 6.0.7**
- One-eyed ghouls (left or right eye only) now have a stronger-looking kakugan: more red cracks inside the eye, and more, longer, thicker veins spreading out over the brow, temple and cheek. Two-eyed ghouls look the same as before. Visual only.
- Includes the 6.0.6 fixes: ghouls can't eat normal food, and AppleSkin's icons no longer draw over the flesh reserve bar.
- 6.0.7 works with any 6.0 server and players.
